name: Crystal City Fall 2022
information: This is a series competition with [River Hill Fall 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RiverHillFall2022). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for River Hill Fall 2022, your registration for this competition will be rejected. This competition will take place in the Arlington Ballroom. No outside food is allowed in the venue, however there are nearby restaurants a short walk away from the venue. COVID-19 SAFETY INFORMATION: To prevent overcrowding in the venue, we are limiting each competitor to one guest only. Competitors should not attend the competition if experiencing symptoms of COVID-19, or if they were exposed to someone with COVID-19.
